basis: Alice holds the glass_table anchor at the foot of table leg 1 for the whole group. She lets go of the leg at t=1.2, sinks down onto the flagstones at t=2.6 and sits with her back against it, turned out into the hall (yaw 2.5214, the reverse of the leg-facing yaw she held through sh053), and cries from t=4.4. In sh055 she sits up off the floor at t=8.8 and scolds herself slightly screen-left at a second person who is not there; she never leaves the spot. At 0.254 m her seated head is 0.18 m off the flags, so both lenses sit on the flagstones at 0.20 m.
warnings: sh054 puts her at about 0.30 of frame width and low in the frame, leaving the whole open right side and upper two thirds empty, as composition asks; the lens tilts about 10 degrees up from 0.20 m so the glass leg runs out of the top of frame.
sh055's 50 mm close on a 0.033 m face needs a 0.12 m standoff. That is geometrically correct for a ten-inch subject and leaves the lens sitting on the flagstones in front of her.
